description: Disproved independent physical item bank retained as a migration tombstone.
verification_method: The historical extent starts inside the canonical 94×16-byte skills table and is byte-for-byte its misaligned slice. This disproves a separately writable physical item bank at 0x546100 without claiming exhaustive knowledge of logical consumers.
notes: Legacy item writes are diagnostic-only. A future item structure needs an independent ROM identity.
